name: Concepcion Rentería
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Concepcion Rentería is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 45, his face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and he has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — he has the city in his blood, its rhythms in his bones, its cruelty in his expectations. He works as a wheelman out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Concepcion Rentería describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
coping_mechanisms: Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments

speech_patterns.vocabulary: the Gray Zone street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "Get in, sit down, hold on. Questions can wait until we're not being shot at."
"This vehicle has been modified for speed, armor, and my personal comfort. Two of those help you."
"I know every street in this district the way you know your own face."

story_hooks: Hadiya Akerlund-Mensah-Bonsu's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Hadiya Akerlund-Mensah-Bonsu owes a personal debt to
Someone is impersonating Hadiya Akerlund-Mensah-Bonsu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Hadiya Akerlund-Mensah-Bonsu functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters. Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Northern European (31.9%) / South Asian (24.4%) / Hispanic/Latin American (18.5%) / Eastern European (13.5%) / Sub-Saharan African (11.7%). Concepcion's ancestry creates a striking convergence: Northern European bone structure and fair undertones blend with South Asian warmth and facial geometry, Latin American golden midtones, Eastern European pallor in certain lights, and Sub-Saharan richness in skin depth. The result is a face that reads differently depending on angle and lighting—sometimes cool, sometimes warm, always complex.
physical_description.build: Lean and loose-limbed with corded muscle definition. Low body fat, long-limbed frame optimized for fluid movement rather than bulk. Shoulders broad but not overdeveloped; everything spare and functional.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped fade, maintained with military precision
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with complex undertones—South Asian base enriched by Sub-Saharan depth, tempered by Northern European coolness in undertones, brightened by Latin American golden warmth. Medium saturation, matte finish, no artificial luminosity. Appears slightly different in warm versus cool light.
physical_description.complexion: Angular, geometric face with high cheekbones that reflect Northern European prominence softened by South Asian facial structure and enriched by Sub-Saharan bone density. Strong mandibular line slightly softened by South Asian genetics. Skin clean and scarred—old line across left temple, thin scar along right mandible. No facial hair; clean-shaven daily. Crow's feet and a horizontal line between brows from twenty years of focus.
distinguishing_marks: Linear scar across left temple, approximately 8cm, pale and thin—old knife wound
Thin scar tracking along right mandible from jaw angle toward chin—surgical precision, recent (3-4 years)
Burn scarring on right forearm, faint and silvered, approximately 5cm diameter—old thermal weapon exposure
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retractable monofilament whip housing visible in left forearm as faint chrome plating beneath skin with subtle seams visible when forearm is flexed. Matching hardware on both forearms where pop-out blade mounts are seated beneath dermis. No LED indicators or decorative chrome—pure function, minimal visibility to untrained eye.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy of motion. No wasted gesture. Posture upright but not rigid—spine aligned, shoulders relaxed. Walks with measured, ground-eating stride. Stillness is his default state; motion is always purposeful. Eyes track continuously in peripheral vision. Hands remain loose and available.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical hybrid. Matte-finish aramid-weave jacket (charcoal, no logos) layered over a fitted compression shirt in black. Tactical trousers with reinforced seams and thigh cargo pockets, worn gray. Scuffed military-grade combat boots, black leather, recently maintained. Minimalist smart-watch on right wrist (encrypted, GLMZ-tier infrastructure compatible). No unnecessary ornamentation. Everything serviceable, replaceable, unremarkable.

image_prompt: Concepcion Rentería, 188cm tall lean-muscled operative, mixed-ancestry face with Northern European bone structure softened by South Asian geometry and enriched by Sub-Saharan depth. Warm medium-brown skin with complex undertones, high cheekbones, strong mandible. Short black hair with silver at temples, dark unaugmented eyes. Clean-shaven with surgical scars along right mandible and temple, burn scarring on right forearm. Matte charcoal aramid jacket over black compression shirt, gray tactical trousers, military combat boots. Faint chrome plating visible on forearms beneath skin where blade housings sit. Posture upright and economical, hands loose and ready. Standing in dim GLMZ corridor lit by cool neon-blue emergency strips and warm amber ambient lighting, creating complex shadows across his face. GLMZ, functional and dangerous, utterly unremarkable appearance concealing lethal augmentations. --ar 2:3 --v 6
